$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for compose-revise-document (spaarkeai-compose-r2 DEF-11). Normalized OpenAI-function-parameters subset (validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests + jps-validate). documentText is the whole loaded document's current text (Wave-2 session doc text) — the agent loop / Compose surface supplies it from the open document, not from Dataverse. Matter/firm playbook + precedent grounding is supplied by the retrieval layer (not a maker-provided input field). Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — use the object-level required array). No actionId here — it is assigned in Dataverse at deploy time. actionCode carries NO version suffix (owner hygiene).

revisionIntent.description: The chosen revision intent for this pass: align-clauses (rewrite deviations from the matter/firm playbook), flag-risks (anchored review comments only, no rewrite), improve-clarity (rewrite ambiguous/redundant passages), or custom (follow the instruction field).

instruction.description: Optional free-text refinement of the revision request. Required context when revisionIntent is 'custom'; optional guidance for the other intents (e.g. 'focus on the indemnification section').

documentText.description: The whole loaded document's current text (the Compose editor's open document, Wave-2 session doc text) this revision pass operates over. Every emitted target_text must be a verbatim substring of this field.
